explanation: Unfold Impl.run: on the valid inputs the machines output encodeTuple of one variable, which decodeTuple 1 recovers (decodeTuple_encodeTuple). So Enc(phi, beta) is the point mass at [beta] for satisfiable phi and at [false] otherwise, and Dec(phi, w, [b]) is the point mass at [b]. Correctness: for (phi, w) in the relation, phi is satisfiable, so decryption returns [beta] with probability 1 >= 1 - 2^-128. False-statement security: for unsatisfiable phi the two challenge laws are equal, so the gain (difference of acceptance probabilities)^2 is 0 and 2^128 * 0 <= cost A. No premises; the cost bound is N := WE.cost impl by reflexivity.
